name: GPU Based Single-Pass Raycasting
definition: A volume rendering technique where the volume is traversed along a single ray per pixel. It is implemented in the Volume Rendering Component as a GPU-based single-pass raycaster, requiring modern graphics hardware.
summary: GPU Based Single-Pass Raycasting is a volume rendering technique that traverses volumes along single rays per pixel using a single-pass fragment shader, distinguishing itself from polygonal and slicing methods by avoiding their expressive and artifact limitations.
